description: Fields of a holdout evaluation file (state.md#2.5): JSON with commit, seed, scores, symptoms, and walled_findings (the full form of scenario-review findings and of any finding located under holdout/). scores and symptoms are the holdout data of the evaluator's step records
x-note: (holdout-data.schema.json); the design gives no required list.

scores.description: Scenario scores as the holdout-evaluator returned them; the score objects of holdout-data.schema.json.

symptoms.description: Symptoms as the holdout-evaluator returned them; the symptom objects of holdout-data.schema.json, with no location and no scenario text.

walled_findings.description: The full form of walled findings, stored only here and in the step records under runs.
